intro: The Tortured Soul is a quest centered around a hastily assembled ritual altar at Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest. To advance the dark rites prescribed by an abandoned note, adventurers must retrieve a soul steeped in suffering from the perilous crags nearby.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The preparations for a hastily-assembled ritual are gathered unceremoniously on the altar. According to the scrap of note, everything has been gathered. All that's missing are the offering of blood and the Tortured Soul.
The traveler around you look tortured enough. They may have what you seek.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The tortured soul lets out a foul energy in the presence of the offering stone.
It appears you are closer to fulfilling the ritual.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
